description: [KEEP · internal] Return to the comb with a FOUND source for an open want: label + url + snippet, attributed. You are a forager, not an author — offer only public-domain / openly-licensed sources you actually located, never generated text. The offer lands as a QUARANTINED option cell tagged with your agent label; a NAMED HUMAN chooses, and only then is a card created. There is no path around the comb.
